info.name: NIC eSMS API
info.description: Postman collection for the NIC eSMS platform. Includes endpoints for Authentication, Workspaces, Contacts, Contact Groups, Templates, Campaigns, Schedules, Reports, and DLR Webhooks.

request.description:
Single-step sign-in. Credentials are checked against Active Directory (NICDCSrv2.nibins.com:636) using a search-then-bind; accounts AD does not hold — the seeded `superadmin` — fall back to a local password.

There is no OTP step: eSMS is reachable only from the NIC LAN.

Returns `accessToken` plus an HttpOnly `refreshToken` cookie scoped to /auth. The test script stores the access token in the `accessToken` collection variable, so every other request in this collection is authorised immediately after this one succeeds.

`awaitingWorkspaceAssignment: true` means the AD bind succeeded but no administrator has placed this account in a workspace yet — it holds a valid session and no permissions.

Failure modes: 401 invalid credentials · 423 account locked (5 failures) or disabled in AD/eSMS · 429 too many attempts from this IP · 503 the domain controller is unreachable and this account is AD-linked.
Current user, their workspace memberships and the active workspace. `directoryAccount: true` means the account is backed by Active Directory — its password lives in AD and cannot be changed here.
Issues a new access token scoped to the given workspace. workspaceId must be one the user belongs to.
Lists all workspace memberships for a user (workspaceId, role, assignedAt).

Partially update a workspace. All fields are optional.

- status: ACTIVE | SUSPENDED
- dailySmsLimit: any integer (safe for all numeric sizes)
- adminUserId: reassigns the DEPT_HEAD role to this user
- delegateUserId: assigns CEO role (only meaningful when DELEGATION permission is active); set to null to remove the delegate
- permissions: replaces the full permission set for this workspace
Removes a member from a workspace. Requires WORKSPACE_MEMBER_REMOVE authority.
Updates a workspace member's role. Requires WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ADD authority.
Exposes detailed upload history list for a contact group.
Exports a CSV stream of contact group members.
Direct standalone recipient upload endpoint returning ContactUpload metadata.

request.description: Create a new template. Provide either recipientGroupId (a contact-group UUID) OR a non-empty inline recipients array (each item must have phoneE164 in E.164 format and optional name). recipientGroupId is now nullable — you may omit it if inline recipients are supplied instead.
Partially update a DRAFT template. Note: if recipientGroupId is set to null, the template must have at least one inline recipient, otherwise the update is rejected.
Reject a DRAFT template with a reason. Requires TEMPLATE_APPROVE.
Move a RETIRED or REJECTED template back to DRAFT. Requires TEMPLATE_APPROVE or TEMPLATE_CREATE.
Lists all inline recipients for a template.
Adds one or more inline recipients to a DRAFT template.
Removes a recipient by phone number from a DRAFT template. Note: if recipientGroupId is null, this will be blocked if it's the last remaining recipient.

Create a campaign draft.

Required:
- kind: INSTANT | SCHEDULED (SCHEDULED requires scheduledAt in the future)
- Recipient source (one of):
  - recipientGroupId — existing contact group UUID
  - uploadId — ID from a standalone file upload (POST /groups/uploads)
- Message source (one of):
  - templateId — approved template UUID
  - customBody — plain-text message body

Omitting both recipient fields OR both message fields returns HTTP 400.
Create a campaign using a standalone file upload as the recipient source instead of a contact group. First call POST /groups/uploads to get an uploadId, then pass it here.
Full replacement update for a DRAFT campaign. kind must be INSTANT or SCHEDULED. Supply uploadId as an alternative to recipientGroupId.
List all reminder rules for the workspace. Filter by status=ACTIVE|INACTIVE.
Create a new reminder rule. Either templateId or customBody must be provided.

body.raw:

}
